note: Standard, non-promotional prices as read from each programme's page or a published guide on the date shown. A price is listed only where a source states one and confidence is at least medium; everything else is null and the screen sends the member to the programme's own site. Prices change often and promotions beat them: treat every figure as an estimate. source_url is only ever an exact page a researcher read or a search result showed.

virgin-flyingclub.name: Virgin Atlantic Flying Club
virgin-flyingclub.note: Plus a one-off fee of $22 per purchase (the page says £15/$25 per 1,000 points and £15/$22 per transaction).
virgin-flyingclub.source: Virgin Atlantic's own page, read directly

turkish-ms.name: Turkish Airlines Miles&Smiles
turkish-ms.note: Includes VAT, minimum 1,000 miles. You must be signed in to buy.
turkish-ms.source: Turkish Airlines' page, from a search summary

emirates-skywards.name: Emirates Skywards
emirates-skywards.note: The cap is 100,000 a year for Blue and Silver and 200,000 for Gold and Platinum, buying and gifting together. Some country pages differ: check yours.
emirates-skywards.source: Emirates' page, from a search summary

aeroplan.name: Air Canada Aeroplan
aeroplan.note: Before taxes, minimum 2,000 points, usually up to 250,000 a transaction. Sign in to Aeroplan and look for Buy points.

alaska.name: Alaska Atmos Rewards
alaska.note: $35 per 1,000 plus 7.5% US federal tax. The 150,000 a year cap is for members without elite status.

american.name: American AAdvantage
american.note: 2,000 miles cost $75.25 including tax. The cap includes miles you gift.

qatar-privilege-club.name: Qatar Airways Privilege Club
qatar-privilege-club.note: Qatar sells Avios inside your Privilege Club account (look for Buy Avios). The price depends on the country of your account and on promotions, and no figure for India is published, so open your account to see it.

ba-executive-club.name: British Airways Executive Club
ba-executive-club.note: Sold inside your Executive Club account (Buy Avios). The price depends on your account's country and on volume. No current published price.

finnair-plus.name: Finnair Plus
finnair-plus.note: Sold inside your Finnair Plus account (Buy Avios), priced in your account's currency, with regular sales. No stable price to quote.

iberia-club.name: Iberia Plus
iberia-club.note: Sold inside your Iberia Plus account (Buy Avios). No stable price to quote.
iberia-club.source: LoyaltyLobby and Traveling For Miles (2023 to 2025)

krisflyer.name: Singapore Airlines KrisFlyer
krisflyer.note: KrisFlyer sells miles to signed-in members. We could not confirm the current price.

flying-blue.name: Air France-KLM Flying Blue
flying-blue.note: Sold inside your Flying Blue account. One guide put it near $30.50 per 1,000 in April 2026, but we could not confirm it on the official site.

jal-mileage-bank.name: JAL Mileage Bank
jal-mileage-bank.note: JAL does not sell miles to members.
